method: Every visible divergent branch was compared to canonical main. Heads with commits not already reachable were attached as additional parents to no-tree-change merge commits. Similarity never substituted for ancestry. A retained branch is research provenance, not an alternate current tree.
tree_admission: No divergent tree is bulk-admitted. Current law plus explicit main commits decide the active implementation. Every retained mechanism needs current graph identities, a named consumer, controls, lineage and exact-head evidence before activation.

disposition_kinds.absorbed: Current main contains the intended mechanism or deletion under current Idol law; branch remains provenance only.
disposition_kinds.partial_gap: Useful facts/controls/mechanism survive, but the branch implementation is not current-law complete; named gap owns the rest.
disposition_kinds.control_evidence: Keep measurements, counterexamples, refusals and falsifiers; do not activate the branch implementation solely from the result.
disposition_kinds.historical_rejected_surface: Research is preserved, but its language/ontology/source surface is superseded and must never be reactivated wholesale.

admission_rules: Current Idol compact law and constitution determine meaning; branch prose does not.
Legacy .duo, Idsem-current, module/std, call-shaped indexing, path/name/AST authority and stale evidence are never reactivated by ancestry.
Controls, counterexamples, measurements, refusals, non-results and unimplemented gaps remain binding research inputs.
Performance mechanisms require exact-head observation-equivalent Pareto evidence before current claims.
Where no performance mechanism is activated, active implementation must preserve the strongest executable baseline.
A branch ref is disposable after its head is reachable from main and its disposition is represented here; Git ancestry, not the ref name, preserves research.
